flags.title: No Venetian event is confirmed single-entry / freezeout
flags.detail: All 37 DSE IV structure sheets were read on 2026-11-17. None states a re-entry or freezeout rule for single-flight events; omission is not confirmation. Rows remain 'entry rule unverified'. Events #18/#58 (Valuetown) reference 'subsequent buy in's' and are treated as multi-entry. Multi-flight events carry the bagging rule only.

flags.title: Wynn daily events all allow re-entry (Friday adds rebuys + add-on)
flags.detail: Official daily terms confirm re-entry on Mon–Thu $200, Sat/Sun $200 and Nightly $160; the Friday $240 confirms 'Re-entry is NOT allowed' but has unlimited $200 rebuys and one $100 add-on. No Wynn daily qualifies as single-entry.

flags.title: WPT World Championship schedule has internal date/label conflicts
flags.detail: Row 'Nov. 30 Monday 1 p.m. No Limit Hold'em Day 2 $800 $1,000,000' conflicts with the structures T&C, which schedule the $800 event's Day 2 for Dec. 3 at 1 p.m. Shown as printed.; Row 'Dec. 5 Saturday 11 a.m. No Limit Hold'em Day 2 $1,100 $5,000,000' appears next to WPT Prime Day 1A; the $1,600 NLH T&C place its Day 2 on Dec. 5 at 11 a.m. Label conflict on the official PDF. Shown as printed.; Rows labeled 'Dec. 18 Wednesday' appear before rows labeled 'Dec. 17 Thursday'. Dec. 18, 2026 is a Friday; the weekday/date labels on the PDF are internally inconsistent. Shown as printed.; Typos on the official PDF: 'Ladies NIH Championship' (NLH), 'TORS E' (TORSE), 'BadugI' (Badugi).; Super Gold Million ($400 / $3,000,000 GTD) and WPT World Championship ($10,400 + $1,000,000 added) per-event Registration lines were not captured in the 2026-11-17 structures-PDF audit (text-extraction gap); their entry rules remain UNVERIFIED.

flags.title: Super Gold Million & WPT World Championship entry rules unverified
flags.detail: Per-event Registration lines for the $400/$3M Super Gold Million and the $10,400 World Championship were not captured in the structures-PDF audit (text-extraction gap). Flagged, not inferred.

flags.title: No date-specific hotel room quotes captured
flags.detail: Official booking engines did not yield dated totals in this session. Venetian $119/$209 are conditional starting rates with a play requirement, not quotes. All date-specific totals remain blank; per-date official booking links are provided and the scheduled re-check will log quotes when available.

flags.title: Resort fees unverified for Bellagio, Caesars Palace, Harrah's, Horseshoe, ARIA
flags.detail: No official page states an amount (or the page is marketing copy). Third-party figures conflict and are not used. Venetian $55+tax, Wynn $55+tax (bookings on/after Jan 15 2025) and Treasure Island $49.95+tax are verified from official pages.

flags.title: Walking times over 30 minutes: Bellagio/ARIA to Wynn; ARIA to Venetian
flags.detail: All hotel-to-venue cross-property walks were checked on Google Maps using official property addresses on 2026-11-17. Bellagio→Wynn is 32 min, ARIA→Wynn 42 min, and ARIA→Venetian 31 min; all exceed the requested 30-minute limit. Other measured cross-property pairs are 30 minutes or less. Wynn-on-Wynn internal walking time is not published/verified and remains blank.

flags.title: Bellagio Saturday buy-in conflict
flags.detail: Bellagio official sources conflict on the Saturday NLH buy-in ($1,000 vs $1,100) and prior audit could not capture start time/date. Row carried with conflict label; not resolved by inference.

flags.title: 8 AM start target not met by any verified event
flags.detail: The earliest verified starts are 9:10 AM (Venetian Event #46 satellite, Dec 12) and 10:00 AM/10:10 AM for most mains. No official schedule shows an 8:00 AM tournament in the window; the daily plan starts at the earliest verified start.

flags.title: Event durations are labeled estimates
flags.detail: No official source publishes finish times. Plausible-duration estimates (1-day ≈ 10 h, flights ≈ 9 h, turbo/satellite ≈ 4–6 h) drive overlap flags and the daily plan; every such value is labeled as an estimate on the page. The linked official schedule and structure sheets provide the start times and level durations used as inputs.

flags.title: 32 Venetian display titles differ from the official page wording
flags.detail: Schedule keys, event numbers, dates, times, buy-ins, guarantees and sheet mappings reconcile; 32 canonical titles normalize capitalization, punctuation or shorten official display wording. The exact official text and each affected schedule row are preserved in data/verify/venetian_dse_iv_live_2026-11-17.tsv and listed by scripts/verify_live_sources.py. Review title variants; no row was dropped.
